comparison.objective: Tension and pluck a chalk line to make a straight mark; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintaining line tension while lifting and releasing its midpoint differs from concentric countertorque on screw and nut.
comparison.success_condition: Single straight print through the marks and reel returned versus locked angular stop retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual tension management is generic and serves different tested abilities.
